definitions.explanation: The fourth planet from the Sun, known for its reddish appearance. Named with the characters for "fire" and "star" due to its red color.

examples.japanese: {火星|かせい}は{赤|あか}く{見|み}える。
{火星|かせい}に{水|みず}があるかどうかの{研究|けんきゅう}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Research into whether there is water on Mars is progressing.

examples.japanese: いつか{人類|じんるい}が{火星|かせい}に{移住|いじゅう}する{時代|じだい}が{来|く}るかもしれない。
examples.english: The day may come when humanity migrates to Mars.

notes:
KANJI NOTE:
{火|か} (fire) + {星|せい} (star/planet). The name reflects the planet's reddish color, which the ancients associated with fire. This naming convention comes from the Chinese five-element system ({五行|ごぎょう}).

THE PLANETS IN JAPANESE:
All planets in the solar system are named using the five-element system or descriptions:
- {水星|すいせい}: Mercury (water)
- {金星|きんせい}: Venus (metal/gold)
- {火星|かせい}: Mars (fire)
- {木星|もくせい}: Jupiter (wood)
- {土星|どせい}: Saturn (earth/soil)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火星|かせい}{探査|たんさ}: Mars exploration
- {火星|かせい}{移住|いじゅう}: Mars colonization
- {火星|かせい}{人|じん}: Martian
